references.text: Fulfillment of the prophecy that the power (arm) of Eli's house will be broken, which also affects David's house in the time of Solomon's son.
Theological contrast between God's arm removing the support (Eli) and God's hand strengthening the support (David).
Contrast between the judgment that none shall grow old (Eli) and the blessing to tell of God's power to the next generation.
Theological contrast between the removal of the father's house's support (Eli) and the setting up of a nail for the father's house (Isaiah).
